description: Bed Rock leans out over this stretch, four storeys of it, close enough that the lane is in shadow by mid-afternoon. Rain comes off the eaves in one place and has dug itself a trench. A cat has the dry part. A woman works the lane most mornings with a cup and a folded coat, and gets more out of the queue at No Such Thing than she does out of anybody on Kessler Street.
name: Ropewalk
